content.description:
Raging Bull Society is an NFT project and community designed to create a fun space for people to have opportunities to grow their NFT collection and multiply their ADA supply. Raging Bull Holders can look forward to raffle drawings and contests for ADA.

Within the Raging Bull Society, members will be presented with many creative and funs ways to win NFTs or ADA with little to no effort. Just Having a Raging Bull NFT is enough to put you in position to potentially win some ADA or an NFT in our bull rush. Our Bull rush event consists of the Raging Bull team using the community ADA supply to sweep various NFT floors and redistribute them to holders in a random raffle drawing.
